alert_news.title: Wayanad Becomes India’s First E‑Waste‑Free District
bullets: Wayanad district, Kerala, will be officially declared the first e‑waste‑free district in India on 27 Nov 2026
Achieved by collecting 97.26 metric tonnes of e‑waste during a district‑wide drive coordinated by the Suchitwa Mission and Clean Kerala Company

alert_news.title: Assam Discovers India’s First New Sedge Moth Species in a Century
bullets: Glyphipterix brevimucronata, the first new sedge moth species recorded in India in nearly 100 years, discovered near Hollongapar Gibbon Sanctuary, Jorhat district, Assam
Described by ICAR‑IARI scientist Kishore Chandra Sahoo and published in the journal Zootaxa

alert_news.title: Mumbai Launches AI System to Screen Building-Permit Proposals
bullets: India’s first AI-powered construction and building-permission system, CivitTwin, launched by Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) in Mumbai.
CivitTwin conducts virtual pre‑scrutiny of building proposals, flagging missing documents and regulatory violations to reduce delays and improve transparency.

alert_news.title: Shivraj Chouhan unveils India's first homegrown bird flu vaccine
bullets: India’s first indigenous H5N1 bird flu vaccine, developed by ICAR‑NIHSAD in Bhopal, was dedicated by Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
The vaccine enables protection of the poultry sector and marks a milestone in animal health, with a BSL‑4 laboratory to be established at the institute.

alert_news.title: Karnataka to set up India's first govt sports technology centre with Amagi in Bengaluru
bullets: India's first government Sports Technology Centre of Excellence (CoE) to be established in Bengaluru by Karnataka in partnership with Amagi Media Labs.
Centre will focus on sports analytics, deep tech, biomechanics, athlete development and cross‑cutting ecosystem enablers.
Karnataka state government will provide seed funding and infrastructure; operations run by industry professionals.

alert_news.title: Gaganyaan's first uncrewed launch pushed to February 2027: Report
bullets: Gaganyaan, India's first human spaceflight program, will conduct its first uncrewed orbital flight (G1) carrying the Vyommitra humanoid robot.
The launch will test the human‑rated LVM3 launch vehicle, crew module, life‑support systems and recovery mechanisms.
Program approved in January 2019; first crewed flight target May 2022; uncrewed launch now scheduled for February 2027.

alert_news.title: India to unveil indigenous H5N1 poultry vaccine - Telangana Today
bullets: India's first indigenous inactivated H5N1 bird flu vaccine for poultry developed by ICAR‑NIHSAD in Bhopal.
Vaccine targets the HPAI H5N1 strain, aiming to reduce poultry mortality and economic losses from outbreaks.
Developed by Indian Council of Agricultural Research – National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases.

alert_news.title: India's First Government-led Microdrama Series on Scam Awareness Launched
bullets: First government‑led microdrama series on online scam awareness, launched by the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting, Prasar Bharati, SEBI, and I4C.
Series to air on Instagram and Waves OTT, educating the public on common digital scams and promoting the cyber‑crime helpline 1930.

alert_news.title: India's First Hydrogen Production Facility Using Steel Plant Off‑Gases Planned
bullets: India’s first hydrogen production plant using steel‑plant off‑gases, to be built at Tata Steel’s Kalinganagar integrated steelworks in Odisha.
Projected capacity of 10 tonnes of high‑purity hydrogen per day using H2Gen technology to support decarbonisation.

alert_news.title: Gaganyaan Mission Launch Sriharikota; Indian Astronauts Travel March 2028
bullets: India’s first human space mission, Gaganyaan, to be launched from Sriharikota using the human‑rated LVM3 (HLVM3) rocket
First crewed flight scheduled for March 2028, marking India as the fourth country to send humans into space

alert_news.title: Ahmedabad's SatLeo Labs plans 15 microsatellites for mapping Earth temperatures
bullets: India’s first commercial thermal payload in space – SatLeo Labs’ TAPAS‑1 launched 1 Oct 2026 aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9.
Payload equipped with thermal sensors and onboard AI to generate detailed heat‑maps of Earth’s surface.
Future plan to deploy 15 microsatellites by early 2030 for climate monitoring and urban heat‑zone detection.

alert_news.title: General Autonomy wins the race among three of India's top quadrupedal robotics ... - ANI News
bullets: India’s first quadrupedal athletic showcase held at the AI & Robotics Pavilion, Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026, organized by the Government of Karnataka.
Three home‑grown quadrupedal robots (General Autonomy, Strider Robotics, xTerra Robotics) raced a 100‑meter distance in a head‑to‑head competition.
The event marked government endorsement of India’s emerging physical AI ecosystem.

alert_news.title: IIT Kanpur and Bharat1.ai Launch AI Kavach - GKToday
bullets: India’s first AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab, AI Kavach, launched by IIT Kanpur and Bharat1.ai on 18 November 2026
Located at IIT Kanpur, the lab focuses on AI systems in banking, payments, lending and insurance, training over 300 students and professionals annually

alert_news.title: India's First Government-Driven AI University Announced at Bengaluru Tech Summit
bullets: The summit highlighted the launch of India’s first AI university, a government‑driven initiative
The university will feature an AI hub to bring together startups, academia and industry

alert_news.title: India's First Commercial Thermal Payload in Space Launched by SatLeo Labs
bullets: SatLeo Labs’ TAPAS‑1 became India’s first commercial thermal payload in space when it reached orbit on 1 Oct 2026 aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9.
The microsatellite uses thermal sensors and onboard AI to map Earth’s temperature, marking the first commercial thermal satellite mission from India.

alert_news.title: India's First Quadrupedal Athletic Showcase Held in Bengaluru
bullets: Bharat1.ai hosted India’s first quadrupedal athletic showcase at the AI & Robotics Pavilion during the Bengaluru Tech Summit 2026.
The event featured three home‑grown quadrupedal robots racing 100 m, marking the first such competition in India.

alert_news.title: India's First Indigenous H5N1 Chicken Vaccine Dedicated
bullets: ICAR‑NIHSAD in Bhopal developed India’s first domestically produced inactivated H5N1 vaccine for chickens, targeting clade 2.3.2.1a.
The vaccine, dedicated on 20 Nov 2026, is the first Indian vaccine specifically designed to protect poultry against this HPAI strain.

alert_news.title: GIFT City Becomes India’s First MCR2030 Resilience Hub Recognised by UNDRR
bullets: India’s first Making Cities Resilient 2030 (MCR2030) Resilience Hub – GIFT City, Gujarat – designated by UNDRR Asia‑Pacific.
GIFT City joined MCR2030 in July 2022, developed a resilience pathway with risk assessments, emergency response measures, and will serve as a knowledge‑sharing hub for other Indian cities.

alert_news.title: CIAL Operationalises India’s First Transfer Cargo Security Hold Area
bullets: India’s first Transfer Cargo Security Hold Area (TCSHA) – operationalised at Cochin International Airport Limited (CIAL), Kochi.
TCSHA, developed under guidelines of the Bureau of Civil Aviation Security, CISF and Customs, reduces transfer cargo screening to 5 % randomised checks, cutting dwell time and handling costs.

alert_news.title: Air India and Airbus Sign Feasibility Study for India’s First Voluntary Corporate Sustainable Aviation Fuel Programme
bullets: India’s first voluntary corporate Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) programme – feasibility study signed by Air India and Airbus on 17 Nov 2026.
Programme will procure and use SAF on selected routes, issue SAF certificates to corporate customers, and aims to reduce lifecycle emissions from business travel.

alert_news.title: India’s First AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab Launched by IIT Kanpur and Bharat1.ai
bullets: India’s first AI Cybersecurity and Assurance Lab dedicated to securing AI systems in the financial sector, launched by IIT Kanpur and Bharat1.ai on 18 November 2026.

The lab will test AI systems used in banking, payments, lending and insurance, and will train more than 300 students and professionals annually using advanced AI computing infrastructure and cloud resources.

alert_news.title: India’s First Complementary Inter‑State Pumped Storage Power Procurement between MP and UP
bullets: First complementary inter‑state pumped storage procurement between Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh, 500 MW capacity with 6‑hour storage and a 40‑year PPA.
Seasonal capacity‑sharing model: MP uses the capacity from November to April, UP from May to October, reducing procurement cost and enhancing renewable energy integration.

alert_news.title: India's First Government-Driven AI University to be Built in Karnataka
bullets: Karnataka government is constructing India’s first government‑driven AI University, featuring an AI Hub to integrate startups, researchers and industry
The university will serve as a national centre of excellence for AI research, education and innovation
